Tooltip_SL_EmpunaduraSable: An empty hilt. It needs a crystal and power to ignite.
Tooltip_SL_EmpunaduraDobleSable: A long hilt with an emitter on each end. Needs two crystals and power.
Tooltip_SL_CristalKyber: A warm, humming red crystal. The heart of a lightsaber.
Tooltip_SL_SableLuz: Glows red when held. Repair it with batteries or scrap electronics.
